DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV) of the right posterior semicircular canal.

The clinical picture of position-dependent vertigo, positive Dix-Hallpike with horizontal nystagmus, and absence of auditory symptoms is classic for BPPV. No further testing is required; I will proceed with canalith repositioning maneuvers.
